id./param/scenario/cs/b_010_cs_030.pack|cs_: "So the Luminary has awoken. There's no time to lose... the hour has come.
"It's all right. I still have things to do. Until then...
"Ah, good morning, {var:1}. That form suits you. You've never looked so cute.
"Your wounds have healed well. When my people brought you here, you were as battered as a shipwreck.
"Mordegon thinks you dead. To deceive him, I changed you into a fish.
"Many months have passed. In your fish form, you have slept soundly all that time.
"Once fully healed, you will return to human form. Until then, don't overdo it.
"Hee hee. Now you may know how a hooked fish feels... Hee hee.
"You look as if you have many questions.
"The battle you fought, the friends who fought beside you... I saw it all.
"{var:1}. When you are ready to accept everything... follow me."
